blink.name: Blink
blink.desc: Dash through enemies, untouchable, scorching everything on the way.

shell.name: Shell
shell.desc: A firewall bubble: 5 s of immunity. It burns what touches it and reflects shots.

halt.name: Halt
halt.desc: Freeze every enemy and shot for 4 s. Frozen enemies take 30% more damage.

nova.name: Nova
nova.desc: Overload: a blast that sweeps the whole screen and hurls enemies back.

slow.name: Slowdown
slow.desc: Enemies and their shots crawl at 30% speed for 6 s. Your weapons fire 50% faster.

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.desc: Drop a fake signal. Enemies chase it for 6 s, then it detonates.

sight.name: Code Sight
sight.desc: See the world as code for 6 s: invisible ghosts and buried Caches show up, and everything takes +20% damage.

phase.name: Phase
phase.desc: For 4 s you walk through firewalls and enemies. Contact cannot hurt you; shots still can.

leap.name: Leap
leap.desc: Jump far in the direction you move and land with a shockwave.

emp.name: EMP
emp.desc: Wipes enemy shots and jams every shooter for 6 s. Your own drones and powers go dark for 3 s.

hijack.name: Hijack
hijack.desc: Rewrite nearby enemies to fight for you for 8 s, then they self-delete.

levels: Overclocked: recharges 30% faster, lasts longer, hits hardest.
